verdict.rationale: n8n documents an OEM deployment option that embeds and surfaces its interface inside your own product's UI, which covers the core embedding need. However, it requires a separate commercial agreement, and the evidence never addresses white-labeling (rebranding or removing n8n branding) or customer-facing multi-tenancy. Missing for 10: explicit white-label/branding customization docs, embedding mechanics and per-customer tenancy details, independent or hands-on corroboration of OEM embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: n8n's OEM deployment option lets you embed and surface n8n's interface inside your own product's UI.
OEM deployment of n8n requires a separate commercial agreement with n8n.
